name: handler_debug
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported as Debug Information (Text) in the Terminal

origin.description: Write one debug line for each reported progression.
origin.usage: handler_debug(interval = getOption("progressr.interval", 0), intrusiveness = getOption("progressr.intrusiveness.debug", 0), target = "terminal", uuid = FALSE, ...)

arguments.name: interval
arguments.text: Minimum seconds between updates. The default is the option progressr.interval, or 0.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is the option progressr.intrusiveness.debug, or 0.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "terminal".

arguments.name: uuid
arguments.text: If TRUE, append the progressor UUID and the owner UUID. The default is FALSE.

origin.details: Each line is "[time] (dt => +delay) type: step/max (+delta) 'message' {clear=, enabled=, status=}". The type is progression$type. reset clears the clock used for dt. hide and unhide do nothing.
origin.example:
path <- tempfile("dbg")
con <- file(path, open = "wt")
sink(con, type = "message")
handler <- handler_debug(enable = TRUE)
with_progress({
  p <- progressor(steps = 1, on_exit = FALSE)
  p(message = "done")
}, handlers = handler, enable = TRUE, interval = 0, delay_terminal = FALSE, delay_stdout = FALSE, delay_conditions = character())
sink(type = "message")
lines <- readLines(path)
cat("handler_debug logged ", length(lines), " lines and the first type is initiate.\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Write one debug line for each reported progression.

arguments.name: interval
arguments.text: Minimum seconds between updates. The default is the option progressr.interval, or 0.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is the option progressr.intrusiveness.debug, or 0.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "terminal".

arguments.name: uuid
arguments.text: If true, append the progressor UUID and the owner UUID. The default is False.

arguments.name: extra
arguments.text: Further arguments passed to make_progression_handler(), including enable.

translation.details: Each line is "[time] (dt => +delay) type: step/max (+delta) 'message' {clear=, enabled=, status=}". The type is the progression type. reset clears the clock used for dt. The clock text is local to the process. hide and unhide do nothing.
translation.example:
import contextlib
import io

from progressr.evaluate import with_progress
from progressr.progressor import progressor
from progressr.reporters import handler_debug

err = io.StringIO()

def body():
    progress = progressor(steps=1, on_exit=False)
    progress(message="done")

with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
    with_progress(body, handlers=handler_debug(enable=True), enable=True, interval=0, delay_terminal=False, delay_stdout=False, delay_conditions=())
lines = err.getvalue().splitlines()
print(f"handler_debug logged {len(lines)} lines and the first type is initiate.")
